<b>{{PAGENAME}}</b> is produced through [[Alchemy]] at the [[alchemy workbench (tier II)]] and can be consumed to regenerate {{Health}} over time.

==Effect==
On use, the potion will apply the {{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}} buff for a duration of 1 minute. This buff restores {{Health||1}} every 1.5 seconds (restoring {{Health||40}} in 1:00). For a list of all buffs see the [[Effects]] page.
